audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows contradicted their whys. The chart read Teemo, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Teemo while the whys say Level 1 even, Teemo owns 2 through 5, you flip at 6, Teemo takes first item, you take two items.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Volibear, Teemo, Volibear — an exact match for the prose, and consistent with 44.94%: a losing lane you win back on items.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to packet, paired across both layers, ratings inverted.

audit.why: Spikes are already well-shaped: Teemo's 3-5 blind window, your level 6 Stormbringer, his first-item kite restoration, your two-item scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart was described only as 'negates your autos' with no cooldown, and nothing anywhere covered Guerrilla Warfare.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at 680 range — short enough that 'wait for it' is a real plan only if you know the number. It blinds basic attacks, so Frenzied Maul's damage and Sky Splitter both still land; the trade is not dead just because you are blinded. Guerrilla Warfare lets him stay invisible WHILE MOVING inside brush, and he leaves stealth with bonus attack speed, so a facechecked bush is a full trade lost before it starts.
audit.corrected: 7s and 680 range stated, abilities-still-land stated, brush stealth written into the don'ts.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Negates your autos. All-in when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: a flat 7s at 680 range — it erases your autos but does nothing to Frenzied Maul or Sky Splitter.

edits.before: Negates your autos. All-in when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s, and your abilities still land through it.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Negates your autos. All-in when down. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: a flat 7s at 680 range. It kills your autos, not Frenzied Maul or Sky Splitter.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Guerrilla Warfare keeps him invisible while moving in brush — never facecheck.

edits.before: Kite with auto-attacks and W Move Quick
edits.after: Kite with autos and Move Quick's 14s

notes: Three fields (wants.you[2], spikes[1], late) claim Thundering Smash's stun 'lands through the blind'. Thundering Smash stuns on Volibear's next Attack, and Blinding Dart blinds attacks, so the claim looks wrong — but blind-vs-stun-attack interaction is not in the kit files (needsResearch is empty by design) and the mirror audit reached the same dead end. I left all three strings untouched rather than assert either way. See questionsForUser: this is the single most load-bearing claim on the page.
